text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Trainer-san! Would you like to go 
eat burgers together?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I heard they're selling the burgers I used 
to eat all the time back in America!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It is super yummy, you know-. The meat 
juice overflowing from the big patty……

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sweet, thick carrots sauteed in butter! My 
family and I used to buy them all the 
time...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Which is why I want you to have a taste 
too, Trainer, as part of our family!
choice_data_list:
We've got training right after this, you 
know?

We have training right after this, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Dat is precisely why-desu yo! If I eat, I 
can do my best-kara! Pleease!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-mmh!! This smell! I just can't get 
enough of it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer! I'm gonna eat 
a ton and...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it our all in the training 
after this, too!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh... Of all things, a regular day off...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I should have researched 
properly, YES... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Takeout!? Oh! That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it won't take much of your 
training time, so it's all right, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You really are so smart, Trainer-san! I 
totally respect you!
